decisions.reason: The aloe vera line has its own page and fits the core facial care range, so carrying it costs little while its value is still uncertain one year after launch, which keeps the option worth holding.
The hyaluronic serum is only mentioned on the website, but it sits close to the established offer and uses the existing small-batch production, so it is cheap to keep while demand becomes clear.
A cleansing milk is a staple that complements the facial care range and needs few extra resources, and there is no evidence yet that its value will not be realized, so dropping it is premature.
